q: how do you add a configurable product to the cart on the storefront
what does storefront checkout require to place an order - payment method, shipping, login
how does a product with variations behave on the storefront product page

subject: Storefront checkout happens on the /cart page itself; there is no separate checkout route until the order completes.
On vcst-qa a configurable product's PDP has a real Add to cart button, while simple and variation PDPs add via the quantity stepper.

q: is an open cart page re-confirmed before Place order

subject: The master hat PDP's variant picker never resolves to a purchasable variation, so a master page can be a dead end even when its variations are in stock.
